row_semantics: One exact material construction and condition per frequency; Dk/Df combined only when conditions match. Frequency-range design Dk uses min/max and a null point frequency.
unit_policy: Hz, mm and dimensionless relative permittivity/loss tangent; printed original thickness units preserved; only explicit um-to-mm conversion is performed.
review_flag_policy: requires_review marks source conflict, development-only availability or experimental-block transfer. False does not validate an antenna design or make representative values construction-specific. record_flags preserve other qualifications.
missing_value_policy: JSON null / blank CSV is unknown or not applicable. It is not zero.
scientific_limitations: Manufacturer typical values are not guaranteed stackup properties.
No interpolation, extrapolation or material/grade substitution is performed.
The material must be selected by exact construction, resin content and test method; FR-4 is not assigned a universal permittivity.
Copper roughness, anisotropy, cured thickness and solder mask need separate models or measurements where not specified.
Design Dk and process Dk are separate records.
Original PDF physical page numbers are 1-based; HTML table indices in locators are 1-based.
